html: † תִּרְשָׁתָא n.m. Tirshathâ, title of Persian governor in Judaea, according to MeyEntstehung d. Jud. 194 al. = His Excellency (read Tarshathâ) otherwise LagSymm. i. 60 (cf. Arm, Stud. §§ 280, 1680).—As Meyl.c., Scheft93 f. (tarśta, the feared, revered) MossHast. DB Tirshatha CheEncy. Bib. Id.;—הַתּ׳ Ezr 2:63 = Ne 7:65, Ne 7:69 (Baer Gi; v 70 van d. H.); of Nehemiah Ne 8:9; 10:1.
